# Villa SDK

> Passkey authentication for apps. One line to integrate.

## Install

```bash
npm install @rockfridrich/villa-sdk @rockfridrich/villa-sdk-react viem zod
```

## Quick Start

```tsx
import { useVilla, VillaButton } from '@rockfridrich/villa-sdk-react'

function App() {
  const { user } = useVilla()
  return user ? <p>@{user.nickname}</p> : <VillaButton />
}
```

## Vanilla JS

```typescript
import { villa } from '@rockfridrich/villa-sdk'

const user = await villa.signIn()
console.log(user.address, user.nickname)
```

## What It Returns

```typescript
{
  address: '0x...',   // Ethereum address from passkey
  nickname: 'alice',  // User-chosen username
  avatar: '...'       // Avatar URL
}
```
